events.title: Proclamation of the German Empire
events.description: In the Hall of Mirrors at the Palace of Versailles, Wilhelm I of Prussia was proclaimed German Emperor, formally unifying the German states under Prussian leadership during the Franco-Prussian War.
events.significance: Created the unified German nation-state, reshaping the European balance of power and setting the stage for developments leading to World War I.

events.title: Paris Peace Conference Opens
events.description: Delegates from the victorious Allied powers convened in Paris to negotiate the peace settlements ending World War I, a process that produced the Treaty of Versailles.
events.significance: Redrew the map of Europe and the Middle East, created the League of Nations, and imposed terms on Germany that influenced the interwar period.

events.title: James Cook Sights the Hawaiian Islands
events.description: British explorer Captain James Cook became the first recorded European to encounter the Hawaiian Islands, sighting Oahu and later landing on Kauai, and he named them the Sandwich Islands.
events.significance: Opened Hawaii to sustained contact with the Western world, with profound consequences for Native Hawaiian society, trade, and Pacific geopolitics.

events.title: Birth of Montesquieu
events.description: Charles-Louis de Secondat, Baron de Montesquieu, the French political philosopher, was born near Bordeaux. He later authored The Spirit of the Laws, advocating separation of powers.
events.significance: His ideas on the separation of governmental powers strongly influenced modern constitutional democracies, including the United States Constitution.

events.title: Scott's Expedition Reaches the South Pole
events.description: British explorer Robert Falcon Scott and his four companions reached the South Pole, only to find that Roald Amundsen's Norwegian team had arrived about a month earlier. All five died on the return journey.
events.significance: The expedition became a defining story of heroism and tragedy in polar exploration and highlighted the dangers and competitive spirit of the Heroic Age of Antarctic exploration.
